embeddings._comment: Set enabled=false to skip (no ML deps needed)

quality_gates._comment: Set enabled=false for faster runs without quality checks

multi_model._comment: Set enabled=true and add OPENAI_API_KEY / GOOGLE_API_KEY env vars for multi-model

citation_expansion._comment: Expands novelty search via Semantic Scholar citation graph

dashboard._comment: Generates interactive HTML dashboard in output/

attack_loop._comment: Every revision restarts Phase 10→13. GREENLIGHT requires all four phases to survive in the same round. auto uses GPT as independent attacker when OPENAI_API_KEY exists, otherwise Claude.

discovery_grounding._comment: Build novelty/challenge-insight trees and Level 1-4 well-established-solution checks before ideation.

idea_evolution._comment: Three directions evolve independently. Every round generates all three persona revisions, then selects one seed for the next round.

survivor_elo._comment: Relative ranking only. V5 ranks only FINAL GREENLIGHT ideas after falsification/MVE evidence; READY_FOR_MVE is not equivalent to validity.

ideation_memory._comment: Stores feasible directions and fundamental dead ends across runs.

falsification._comment: No empirical evidence => READY_FOR_MVE, never GREENLIGHT. Put executed evidence in output/mve_evidence/IDEA-xxx.json and rerun --falsification-only.
